site.title: Espinoza — music
site.description: Albums by Espinoza: the single “Stay Till Morning”, the meditations “Silence Within”, Andean music Tuta Ukupi and Andes Nights, Neural Lullabies, the songs “Wounds on Paper”, Ella and 2804.

intro.text: I'm Denis Espinoza, a brand designer. I write music for myself first — songs, Andean motifs, lullabies and meditations: what I listen to while working, on the road and before sleep. Here I share it — and more albums are on the way.

outro.title: Listen everywhere
outro.text: All albums are on Yandex Music, Spotify, YouTube Music and other platforms.

2804.description: “2804” — a single of three songs: Stolen Kiss, Cold, For You.

lines: Cold. And all of it — for you.

tracks.p: A kiss that can't be taken back
Cold where the fire used to be
All of it — for you

andes-nights.description: “Andes Nights” — 7 tracks about the Andes and about her: dawn, a stolen kiss, the Andean night, the valley without her.

lines: A kiss. The valley without her.

tracks.p: Dawn over the Andes and the first “good morning”
A kiss stolen from the mountains
Andean night: mist, fire and stars
The valley where she is no more
All about her voice
Evening by the lake and a quiet “good evening”
An argument with pain — and the storm after

ella.description: “Ella” — 8 songs in Spanish about her: love, fever, attraction and nights without her.

tracks.p: All that I am — for her
One more night without you
A truth that's hard to say
A fever you can't hide from
A pull stronger than me
Slow fire
On the other side
Even if you think of me

neural-lullabies.description: “Neural Lullabies” — 11 lullabies and nature sounds for a baby's calm, deep sleep.

tracks.p: A soft lullaby for falling asleep
A cradle of ocean waves
Like on mom's chest: a quiet heartbeat
Night garden and crickets
Wind whispering over the meadow
A gentle stream
Tender rain and fireflies
Brooks under the moon
The soft glow of the night sky
Clouds, like inside mom's tummy
A light breeze of deep sleep

listen.disclaimer:
Listen at a comfortable, low volume and don't place the speaker near the baby's head.

tracks.t: I Don't Want to Love Anymore

stay-till-morning.title: Stay Till Morning
stay-till-morning.description: “Stay Till Morning” — a song in Russian, plus versions in English and Spanish.

tracks.p: Don't go before the dawn
The same night — in English
The same night — in Spanish

tuta-ukupi.description: “Tuta Ukupi” — “inside the night” in Quechua. 9 tracks of Andean music: water, breath, fire, heart, moon, memory, mountains, sun and wind.

tracks.p: Wayra — wind. Dissolving into the mist
Yaku — water. A quiet current inside the night
Samay — breath. The calm of the highlands
Nina — fire. The warmth of a campfire and charango
Sonqo — heart. What beats inside
Killa — moon. A stone path in the moonlight
Yuyay — memory. Thoughts that keep coming back
Apu — spirit of the mountain. Machu Picchu above the clouds
Children of the sun. Sunset over ancient ruins

zen.title: Silence Within
zen.description: “Silence Within” — 11 meditations for body, mind and sleep, in Russian. Espinoza Meditation.

hero.label: Silence Within
hero.sub: 11 meditations for body, mind and sleep · in Russian

tracks.p: Let go of tension — step by step
The ancient “So Ham” practice for a quiet mind
Come back to the body when emotions are too strong
A clear head and a calm start to the day
One task. Full attention

tracks.t: Calm Confidence Before a Big Event
tracks.p: Before a meeting, a performance, an important talk

tracks.t: Restore Energy After a Hard Day
tracks.p: Shake off a heavy day and get your strength back
Talk to yourself as you would to someone close
Yoga nidra for gently falling asleep
When thoughts won't let you sleep
A deep “neti, neti” meditation
